column1: # Shared fixtures for the text transition plan (iOS JBTextTransitionPlan, Android TextTransitionPlan).
# Columns (tab-separated): mode[:unit[:scope]], direction option, old text, new text, expected direction (up|down), expected ops, expected stagger.
# Unit is auto (default), word or whole. Scope (roll only) is all (default), numbers or changed.
# Ops in logical order: =kept -removed +inserted. A space inside a segment is written as ␠. Empty text is written as ∅.
# Stagger: the stagger index of every -removed/+inserted op in order (∅ when nothing changed): its position in logical
# order counted from the first changed position. A removed segment and the one replacing it share a position.
# roll uses numeric's slots; scope all replaces every segment, numbers everything but a shared non-digit
# prefix/suffix, changed only what changed. JS sends direction "up" for it unless told otherwise.
# reveal:<type>[:unit] is the reveal plan (revealPlanForText / TextTransitionPlan.reveal): old text is always ∅,
# every segment is inserted, stagger counts from the first segment. Direction is up or down; anything else is up.
